replies: Let me pause the usual chat for a second. What you just said matters, and so do you. Please reach out to someone you trust right now.

That sounds really heavy, and I'm glad you told me. I can't give you the help you deserve here, so please talk to someone you trust: a friend, family, or a crisis line near you (findahelpline.com lists them).
I'm not the right help for this, but you deserve real help. If you might act on these thoughts, please contact your local emergency number or a crisis line now. You don't have to carry this alone.
